title: Midnighter #12 Wildstorm December 2007 Keith Giffen Rafa Sandoval Chris Sprouse
condition_description: Front cover bright with light wear. Back cover shows edge and spine wear with color rubs along the right edge (close-up pictured). Spine and staples intact.
description:
Midnighter #12 (December 2007), Wildstorm / DC Comics. Written by Keith Giffen, art by Rafa Sandoval, cover by Chris Sprouse and Karl Story. Direct sales edition, $2.99 cover price.

Condition: front cover bright with light wear; back cover has edge wear and color rubs along the right edge and top (see close-up). The "CS KS" on the cover is the printed artist signature.

Back cover: Blue Dragon (Xbox 360) ad.

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
